benefits.title: Students develop purposeful agency and enduring self-direction
benefits.statement: Students can articulate what currently matters to them, including where they remain uncertain, make intentional choices and strengthen their ability to revise direction as they learn more about themselves and the possibilities available to them. They connect knowledge with experience and continue shaping their lives, learning and contribution beyond King’s.
benefits.successLooksLike: Students can articulate and revisit what matters to them, make intentional choices about their King’s experience and adapt their direction as their circumstances, evidence and ambitions change.

benefits.title: Students can navigate a rich opportunity ecology more intentionally and equitably
benefits.statement: Students can identify opportunities relevant to their evolving purposes and understand how experiences connect, with less dependence on prior confidence, networks or institutional knowledge. King’s can use governed patterns of student ambition and need to improve recommendations and shape enrichment provision more responsively.
benefits.successLooksLike: Students from different backgrounds and patterns of study can identify opportunities relevant to their purposes, while decisions about enrichment provision draw on clearer and appropriately governed evidence about student ambition, need and demand.

benefits.title: King’s develops a more coherent approach to supporting purpose and self-direction
benefits.statement: Relevant student-facing relationships share a clearer developmental logic around reflection, transition, aspiration and need. Specialist practice remains where it adds value, while students encounter a more coherent journey rather than disconnected conversations owned by separate services.
benefits.successLooksLike: Trailblazer partners can describe and deliver a coherent purpose and self-direction model across relevant touchpoints, and the elements selected for wider adoption have evidence that they remain useful outside unusually committed local settings.
